$comment: The explicit allowlist. A pair in contrast-pairs.json that falls below its minimum and is NOT listed here fails the gate; a pair listed here that starts passing ALSO fails the gate, so an entry cannot outlive the problem it describes. Each entry is bound to the pair it excuses: `fg`, `bg` (and `fgAlpha` when the pair has one) and `min` must equal the pair's, and `ratio` is the value measured when the entry was written — the gate fails if the pair is re-pointed at other tokens, if its minimum is loosened, or if the measured ratio moves by more than 0.05 in either direction, so an old reason can never cover a new pair or a worse colour. `reason` is mandatory and is what a reviewer reads; `decision` is mandatory and names what would let the entry be deleted. Adding an entry is a design decision, not a build fix — see AGENTS.md.

failures.decision: the disabled primary button is white on slate.300. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls, but 1.52:1 is unreadable rather than merely dimmed. Either darken the disabled fill or switch the disabled label to text.tertiary
